'''Rubassa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian shock trooper|shock trooper]] and a commander of [[Clan Ha'rangir]].<ref name="Ruhnuk" /> Rubassa was also known as '''Three Horn''', as he wore three horns on his helmet. Some of his subordinates saw this as a blatant attempt to curry favor with [[Heta Kol]], who also wore three horns on her helmet, and therefore disliked taking orders from him.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />

==Biography==
Rubassa was first [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Mandalore the Avenger)|encountered]] by [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] in the [[Duros Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] whilst she was hunting down the criminal [[Gauss]] for information on [[Heta Kol]] and the [[Hidden Chain]]. Gauss had hired [[Clan Ha'rangir]] as bodyguards, who were led by Rubassa. The bodyguards, led by Rubassa, were able to prevent Shae Vizla from capturing Gauss, however Gauss was unaware that Shae Vizla's true target was Heta Kol, and Rubassa provided more immediate access to Heta Kol than he did. Shae Vizla secretly placed a tracker on Rubassa, which allowed her to discover the clan's operations of [[Ruhnuk]].<ref name="Snare">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20221209-0|text=“Snare” Short Story|date=2022-09-12}}</ref>

Rubassa was later involved in the clan's operations on Ruhnuk, where he found himself guarding the [[Reconstructed Combat Arena]] whilst it was still under construction. It was there that he was slain, along with two subordinates, by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
